items.title: 462 children sheltered in 13 child-friendly centres in Rasuwa
items.summary: Rasuwa, September 29 Thirteen child-friendly centres have been set up in different parts of the district to protect children affected by disasters and support their psychosocial development. The Nepal Red Cross Society has established and facilitated these centres with support from UNICEF. items.title: NDRRMA Chief Upreti on what Nepal must change after the Bhotekoshi disaster
items.summary: A month after the Bhotekoshi flood, Nepal’s disaster authorities are assessing the damage, planning reconstruction and considering the relocation of settlements in high-risk areas.

items.title: Welcome tourists back—but build resilient systems to keep them safe
items.summary: The Bhotekoshi flood has once again reminded us that Nepal needs a resilient tourism system to withstand major shocks.

items.title: All three major Nepal-China crossings hit by monsoon disruptions ahead of Dashain
items.summary: Floods and landslides have halted trade through Rasuwagadhi-Kerung, Tatopani, and Korala border points. Hundreds of containers remain stranded and supplies disrupted ahead of the festive season.
